born.why: The code improves by using trait-based inference (color/shape) to safely eat novel fruits that match known good species, rather than just tasting everything or leaving unknown fruits, while maintaining starvation overrides and poison avoidance.

The code prioritizes starvation avoidance by eating unknown fruits when hunger is critical, uses smell-based pattern matching to avoid known poisons from past experiences, and eats confirmed safe foods immediately to reduce foraging time, while only tasting uncertain fruits when there is sufficient health margin.

The code prioritizes learning via tasting for unknown fruits while avoiding confirmed poisons, using smell-based generalization to avoid risky species, and switches to immediate eating when safety is established by past experience or trait inference to reduce starvation risk.

The code prioritizes starvation survival by eating unknowns when extremely hungry, uses trait-based generalization to avoid known poisons faster than species-specific memory, and distinguishes between immediate consumption ('eat') for efficiency and carrying ('carry') only for targeted goals.

It prioritizes survival by eating when starving, carrying known-good fruits to pantry for safety, tasting unknowns to build knowledge, and avoiding known poisons, balancing risk and reward based on hunger levels.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisonous fruits, eating known good fruits when not overly hungry, tasting unknown fruits when hunger is manageable to gather data, and resorting to eating potentially harmful fruits only in extreme starvation scenarios.
